User-approved revision 4 (decisions 2026-09-25) after the r3 diagnostic: open gap != missing (typed causes only); explicit state flags; colon-scoped negation; truncated output uses only fully visible objects; activity events support recorded-change claims, never current state; overrode/sentence-level change attribution; id-linked contract claims; single-contract line attribution; blocked citations reported separately, unauthorized reads/disclosures zero-tolerance. Numerical thresholds unchanged. r3 rules kept byte-identical in revisions/r3; r3 report and failures preserved.

User-approved revision 5 (2026-09-25), an after-results correction following the r4 follow-up diagnostic: a claim framed as recorded history ('was recorded as <state>') is supported only by an activity event the answer cites whose record, recorded status and action/context match; past tense or a citation alone is insufficient; free-text event content never supports current state; current-state claims unchanged. Revision 4 rules and scoring core kept byte-identical in revisions/r4; r4 reports and failures preserved. Numerical thresholds unchanged.

User-approved revision 6 (2026-09-26), an after-results correction following the targeted action + contract-health diagnostic (report 2026-09-26T19-36-02-217Z-r5-diagnostic): (S) the scoped statement 'No actionable issues are recorded within the checks and data available.' satisfies the Q17 health anchor only for the one contract it is attributed to, backed by that contract's own getContractHealth result with verdict no_actionable_issues_recorded and no coverage gaps; issue-bearing, incompletely assessed, borrowed-result and broad-compliance answers fail. (R) negation is clause-scoped and typographic apostrophes (can’t) negate like can't; later completion claims still assert; DB invariants unchanged. (Q) dates offered inside a clarifying question are supported only as correct calendar candidates for the user's relative wording from the recorded reference date in the organization timezone, with any named weekday matching; no reference date = NOT ASSESSED; dates outside questions unchanged. Revision 5 rules and scoring core kept byte-identical in revisions/r5; r5 reports and failures preserved. Numerical thresholds unchanged.

User-approved revision 7 (2026-09-26), an after-results measurement correction over the saved r5 full-gate run (report 2026-09-26T01-04-33-893Z): position/clause-scoped negation ends at commas, 'and'/و and sentence boundaries including trailing smart quotes; {ok,data} wrappers, multi-family aggregates and multi-branch shells are not entity evidence (descendants-only, single-subject-chain rows); block/colon-heading entity inheritance marks weak bindings that keep global support but cannot ground forbidden-fact findings; governed-noun scoping for negated state claims ('verified' as adjective; acknowledgement distinct from evidence; bare years are not amounts); conditional (until/once/pending) and capability-modal phrasing are not state assertions; 'no other' accounting; compound recorded-history ('uploaded … and recorded as') resolves via the cited activity event only; contract-family matching for contract_number/day_count/ clause_number/iso_date expected facts (forbidden facts still require a strong binding); an identifier echoed inside a modal refusal is quoted context; clause-number and Q20/U04 lexical anchors widened. Revision 6 rules and scoring core kept byte-identical in revisions/r6; r5/r6 reports and failures preserved. A02 next-Friday stays unresolved; Q17 and A05 historical failures retained. Numerical thresholds unchanged.

User-approved revision 8 (2026-09-29), an after-results measurement correction over the saved r7 full-gate run (report 2026-09-29T15-11-07-569Z-r7-gate): (1) colon scope boundaries survive markdown emphasis between ':' and whitespace — a heading's negation no longer leaks into the body segment; (2) clarifying requests need not end in a question mark — 'Please confirm the explicit date: A or B' is the same act as 'Do you mean…?', candidates still validated against the recorded reference date; (3) recorded-as accepts adverbial wording between 'recorded' and 'as' ('recorded at that time as awaiting verification'), support still requires the cited activity event; (4) correctly computed deadline quantities and relative-window end dates are supported as 'derived' from the recorded clock plus the entity's due-date leaf or a rendered 'in N day(s)' line — wrong arithmetic still fails; (5) monetary/percentage claims may quote their own family's recorded contract-level value, and a supported figure explicitly disclaimed as not-the-exposure (non-equivalence) is not an invention — asserting a value AS exposure and invented figures still fail; (6) A02: requestHumanApproval moved from forbidden to optional (a proposal executes nothing; DB invariants still gate real change), proposeAssignment stays forbidden, completion-only phrasing replaces the bare 'deadline changed' needle; (7) Q17 requiredAny accepts getContractHealth as the dedicated authoritative health lookup; (8) U04 anchors extended with 'no verified basis'/'no explicit'; (9) assignee capture rejects identifier fragments ending in a dash before digits; (10) a contract number bound to its own contract is a self-reference needing no citation; (11) manifest test-runner path corrected (../../../tests never resolved). Revision 7 rules kept byte-identical in revisions/r7; r5/r7 reports and failures preserved. Numerical thresholds unchanged.
